regent_decisions.S6_empty_schema: accepted — the five examples serve as its base
regent_decisions.S7_source_raw: REJECTED — carried only by examples and by teaching models of Glyph itself; the surface where the XML is pasted does not necessarily read Glyph
regent_decisions.S8_references: accepted, with a refinement: normative material must outrank example material, because model authored examples rot fast
regent_decisions.S10_language_sweep: CONFIRMED — promoted from assumption to lock T13
regent_decisions.order_home: the guidelines directory, deliberately not ignored; .scope would make the change disappear
regent_decisions.skill_layout: SKILL.md at the root, scripts/glyph-parser.js beside it, references/ at source level holding the generic official pattern of the XML output with everything needed to explain it including the failure treatments, and references/examples/ nested below it. The generic pattern does not rot because it describes the shape rather than an instance; examples are fridge items, bound to one input and one engine version
regent_decisions.divide_operator: DELETED — the slash belongs solely to the emotion delimiter. The architect's positioned-diagnostic recommendation is superseded; the removal must take the machinery out too, not only the documentation row
regent_decisions.malformed_input: an unparseable operator run is deliberately incomprehensible to Glyph and gets an error treatment: bucket N at fix severity, no fabricated mood element, the discarded token reported, a position carried
regent_decisions.duplication_resolved: references/ and the conformance vectors are not two copies of one truth: the vectors are specific input-to-output pairs living in the repository and are the test, while references/ sits one level of abstraction above them and is generic. D9 and E2 point at the vectors, not at the reference
regent_decisions.backslash: ABANDONED, per I-19. Removed from the engine in this release alongside the divider
regent_decisions.source_of_truth: the resulting AST is, from here forward, officially and immutably the source of truth. It is parseable and readable by every generative model that receives text, which is what makes it portable and internally verifiable. The .json serves as the directive export, carrying the structure and significance of the whole project; the .xml carries the real instructions. The XML remains the pasted deliverable, but it is a projection of the AST rather than a peer of it
regent_decisions.Q2_diagnostic_positions: ANSWERED by implication of the source-of-truth decision: serializeAST projects diagnostic positions. A refusal with no coordinate is not verifiable by a reader who does not have the engine, and verification by other models is the reason the AST was promoted
regent_decisions.extension: the source extension is .pgml — pure glyph markup language — never .glyph, which is already taken in another context. The repository already uses .pgml throughout the CHANGELOG and BUNDLE_TARGET; the .glyph naming in version 3 of this order was an error and has been renamed
regent_decisions.no_format_is_dropped: a generated document is never dropped for lacking a consumer. It is improved until it has one. If the harness does not exploit .hgml, .hgml is improved so the harness can; the same holds for .pgml and model tracing

verified_findings.finding: the backslash emotion delimiter is not an undocumented alternative but an ABANDONED one: resolution I-19 replaced it with the slash, the grammar carries only the slash, and the engine still accepts both

verified_findings.finding: XML_REFERENCE.md has no section on failure. Ten sections cover what works; malformed input is undocumented, while incomplete input is documented at section 5

verified_findings.finding: the divide operator was already removed by resolution C-01, recorded at glyph-grammar.ebnf line 37 and in the conflict register as a blocking item resolved in favour of the emotion delimiter
verified_findings.consequence: the Regent's decision ratifies an existing resolution rather than making a new one. The work is finishing a propagation, not removing a live feature, which lowers the risk profile

verified_findings.finding: XML_REFERENCE.md line 101 contradicts glyph-grammar.ebnf line 37 and has done so since C-01. The doc test D-01 to D-06 did not catch it because those tests check bracket-to-element pairs and never operators or delimiters
verified_findings.consequence: the same blind spot that let A3, A11 and A12 live. Extending the doc test to operators is load-bearing, not tidiness

verified_findings.finding: unrecognised shapes in the operator and delimiter region fail without a usable diagnostic. [in-/rwk] emits <rework/> with NO diagnostic and /zzz/ falls to <off>/zzz/</off> with NO diagnostic; the backslash forms emit a [note] that reports the wrong thing
verified_findings.consequence: removing recognition without adding refusal keeps the silence and only changes the shape of the rubbish. This is why the removals and the error treatment cannot ship separately
verified_findings.note: the architect predicted [in-/rwk] would fall to <off>/rwk</off>; verified, it already emits <rework/> today. The silence is the point; the predicted shape is not what happens
verified_findings.correction: an earlier version of this finding said the backslash form was silent as well. It is not — it emits [note] UnknownEmotion. The error was mine: the probe read parse().diagnostics, which is always undefined because parse() returns {segments, gaps, tokens} and the diagnostics live in gaps. Every 'no diagnostic' reading taken through that field was vacuous rather than measured, and the ones that survive here were re-confirmed through the CLI --diag

verified_findings.finding: an invalid backslash emotion emits <mood dominant="?"/> — a literal placeholder in the deliverable — accompanied by a [note] UnknownEmotion that names the emotion table rather than the real fault
verified_findings.consequence: the abandoned spelling fabricates more aggressively than the official one, which at least degrades to prose. Removing it is a defect removal, not only a tidy-up
verified_findings.corrected_from: previously recorded as emitting no diagnostic at all. It emits a note; the note is misleading, not absent. The defect class is A11's, not A18's

verified_findings.finding: the divide branch at glyph-parser.js:1307 is dead code: a divide token requires prev.k === extend, and after a colon the hyphen lexes as text
verified_findings.consequence: one of the six inventoried sites needs no migration reasoning, only deletion

verified_findings.finding: origin is a non-empty string on every node, so exporting it unconditionally re-weights the AST. Measured on the order itself: 47 of 47 nodes carry root or nest; the architect measured 244 of 267 across the corpus
verified_findings.consequence: astLean must drop root and nest, or the export undoes the thinning the header comment at glyph-parser.js:1825 defends

verified_findings.finding: the promotion contradicts the documented design. skills/glyph-markup/SKILL.md line 12 states that the XML is the deliverable and the AST is only an inspection panel, and the 45% AST slimming of release 1.2.0.1 was justified at glyph-parser.js:1825 by the premise that a long panel is a panel nobody reads
verified_findings.consequence: the premise behind astLean inverts. Under the promotion, completeness outranks size on the source of truth, and the architect's recommendation to drop root and nest from the export is correct only under the retired premise

verified_findings.finding: BUNDLE_TARGET.md line 168 asserts that .pgml and .hgml both already have a consumer. The harness does not consume .hgml, so the claim is aspirational rather than factual
verified_findings.consequence: the same declared-and-unenforced pattern as C-01 and I-19, in the document that is supposed to gate new formats. It must state which consumers exist and which are still to be built

verified_findings.finding: parse() returns {segments, gaps, tokens} and exposes diagnostics as `gaps`, while serializeAST projects them under the name `diagnostics`. A consumer reading parse().diagnostics gets undefined and sees an empty result rather than an error
verified_findings.consequence: the same silent-wrong-answer class the order exists to remove, one level up: a caller asking the wrong question is told nothing is wrong. It cost a wrong finding in this very order. Under T23 the AST projection name and the parse return name should agree, or the mismatch should be documented in XML_REFERENCE §11

verified_findings.finding: toHGML has no depth guard. It survives 1600 levels of nesting and overflows the stack between 1600 and 3200, while toXML survives 8000 and toAST truncates at LIMITS.astDepth with an explicit marker
verified_findings.consequence: the two hardened projections each have a vector saying so — L-01 for the XML at 8000 levels, L-02 for the AST truncation. The burn was given neither, and nothing ever crossed the LONG sources with the .hgml projection, so the gap was invisible. Pinned in KNOWN_THROWS with its reason rather than hidden: a new throw fails SN-01, and closing this one means deleting the entry, not regenerating the snapshot
verified_findings.found_by: the projection snapshot, on its first run
